title: afs capability
description: What afs can do for whoever runs it.

entities.name: Session-aware file reading and search
entities.description: Reads, searches, lists, stats and outlines local files on request, as JSON, and remembers within a session what it already sent.
entities.responsibility: Answers JSON requests about the local file system with bounded replies, and within one session replaces content the caller already has with an unchanged marker or a line diff.
access: Anyone who can run the binary; nothing in the code checks who the caller is.
Any path, absolute or relative to the working directory, that the operating system lets the running user read; there is no root or allow-list.
Read-only: no operation changes a file.
